typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblcalypsotradeservRedPairCdsSng_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as string,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string,
		LONG_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromleattribute
fromleattribute derive({Copy of LONG_NAME} = LONG_NAME,
		{Copy of ATTRIBUTE_TYPE} = ATTRIBUTE_TYPE,
		{Copy of SHORT_NAME} = SHORT_NAME,
		{Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = toString(LEGAL_ENTITY_ID),
		{Copy of ATTRIBUTE_VALUE} = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Issuer_Short_Name as string,
		Legal_Entity_Id as string,
		Issuer_Long_Name as string,
		Attribute_Value as string,
		Attribute_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Issuer_Short_Name = {Copy of SHORT_NAME},
		Legal_Entity_Id = {Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID},
		Issuer_Long_Name = {Copy of LONG_NAME},
		Attribute_Value = {Copy of ATTRIBUTE_VALUE},
		Attribute_Type = {Copy of ATTRIBUTE_TYPE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblcalypsotradeservRedPairCdsSng_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblcalypsotradeservRedPairCdsSng
